trust_decision.summary: The identity of a cached numpy audio output must include sample rate, dtype, shape and format; it is decided in one place, gradio/processing_utils.py:save_audio_to_cache(), which keys the cache directory only on data.tobytes().

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says the audio cache key ignores metadata 'when saving numpy audio outputs'; the only function that builds that key is save_audio_to_cache(), and fix.diff:24 changes exactly its one line that hashes data.tobytes().

fix_sites.entry_point: gr.Audio output postprocessing on the app's predict API - both the (sample_rate, np.ndarray) branch (gradio/components/audio.py:295-303) and the filepath/URL re-encode branch (gradio/components/audio.py:304-316), plus any direct caller of the public processing_utils helper
fix_sites.module_kind: shared processing utility / content-addressed file cache helper

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The nearest neighbour a solver can wave away is the bytes branch (gradio/components/audio.py:288-293): raw file bytes are already self-identifying, so 'metadata must be in the key' can be read as a numpy-array-only requirement, exactly the path the report names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Cache deduplication must survive key normalisation: np.int64(8000) and 8000 for the same array must resolve to the same cache directory (fix.diff:77-86 asserts this), and repeated postprocessing of identical audio must reuse the same entry rather than growing a new directory per call. A naive fix that json-dumps the raw sample_rate either raises TypeError on numpy scalars or splits one logical output into two cache entries.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: gradio/processing_utils.py:186-190 (one directory per logical output); fix.diff:77-86

O6_input_shapes: sample_rate: 8000 vs 16000 for identical raw samples (fix.diff:56-61)
dtype: int16 vs uint16 with identical bytes (fix.diff:65-67)
sample_rate given as a numpy scalar, normalised with int() (fix.diff:77-86)

O7_producer.where: gradio/processing_utils.py:186-190 builds/writes the on-disk cache entry via audio_to_file() at :189; the directory name is stable across processes because the hash seed is persisted (gradio/utils.py:612-623) and the cache root is the app temp dir (gradio/blocks.py:149)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An audio-bytes cache helper (save_audio_bytes_to_cache(data, sample_rate, format, cache_dir)) used by gr.Audio's bytes branch at gradio/components/audio.py:288-293, keying on the byte hash plus caller-known metadata
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same file, same content-addressed pattern, and the existing bytes branch already caches audio under a key that cannot see the component's requested format (it passes only file_name='audio'), so a maintainer patching 'cache key ignores metadata' could plausibly have written the fix there instead.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Stream finalisation writes the converted file to a path derived from the byte-keyed cache entry (Path(output_file.path).with_suffix(desired_output_format)), leaving desired_output_format out of the key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Streaming audio is a separate output path maintained by the same component; a format-aware cache key here is a natural follow-up written by the same authors, and the metadata (desired format) lives only at the call site, not in the cached object.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A sibling media-cache key built from the repo's existing numpy content hash (shape + dtype + bytes) rather than the bare bytes hash used at gradio/processing_utils.py:186
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The correct numpy identity already exists in gradio/caching.py and in gradio/image_utils.py:88 (arrays converted through _convert(arr, np.uint8) before hashing), so a maintainer adding a fourth media cache would plausibly reuse one of these patterns; these are WHERE-type copies only, not how-type variants.

O9_family: content-addressed cache key ignores item metadata, so distinct logical outputs collide on one path (advisory assigns CWE-327; practically incorrect resource identity / cache confusion)

O10_build.toolchain: hatchling via pyproject.toml (build-backend at pyproject.toml:7, requires-python >=3.10 at pyproject.toml:14), requirements.txt with pydub and numpy; pytest configured in pyproject.toml:183
O10_build.project_tests: test/test_processing_utils.py::TestAudioPreprocessing (gradio/test_data/test_audio.wav; gradio_temp_dir fixture at test/conftest.py:62) and test/components/test_audio.py; the fix's own tests patch gradio.processing_utils.audio_to_file (fix.diff:55), so no ffmpeg is needed for the in-scope cases

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep hash_bytes(data.tobytes()) and append only the sample rate and format (or json-dump the sample_rate as-is), leaving dtype and shape out of the key and breaking dedup of numpy-scalar sample rates.

out_of_scope_notes: gradio/image_utils.py:88 save_img_array_to_cache converts arrays to uint8 before hashing, so image array dtype is dropped from the key as well - a similar-but-separate property outside this advisory's audio protection.
unverified: Advisory body text for GHSA-6655-8PH2-63J3 / CVE-2026-10783 was not available (only the one-line summary), so I could not compare the report's stated example against the affected routes.
repo_mb is unknown (no shell available to size the tree; the repo has 175 Python files under gradio/ plus a large JS frontend, so it is not tiny).
